meta.docSubtitle: Regime, geometry, materials, propulsion, mass — and what telemetry actually shows
meta.author: Guns Only · airframe SE
meta.note: Teaching deck. Numbers are tagged closed / surrogate / provisional / fiction / open finding. Mach-4 dash is aspirational fiction; OFT energy-ladder peaks ~M3.69. CMC materials freeze stands. Skin HUD is lagged structure, not instantaneous recovery.

slides.title: How this jet is built
slides.subtitle: First principles: mission → geometry → materials → propulsion → mass. Capture kit second.
slides.thesis: Design for one decisive pass in thin air. Measure what the sim actually does. Flag what is still too good.

slides.heading: Two ceilings, one honest story.
slides.subhead: Materials and thrust bind differently. Telemetry already tells you which claim is soft.

statBig.label: peak Mach on intercept OFT energy-ladder (measured)

statWeekly.label: briefing / design-dash claim — fiction until retuned

slides.bottomLine: CMC at 1200 °C is a materials freeze. Sustained air-breathing Mach 4 is not proven by that freeze — or by the map.

slides.heading: A thrust, not a slash.
slides.subhead: Dispersed land basing → climb clean → overlap TBCC → dash thin → one attack → egress → trap light.

rows.label: Launch
rows.detail: Buried gallery → 12° ramp · ~110 m/s off rail · ~1.5 Vs at gross

rows.label: Climb
rows.detail: → FL560 @ ~M0.90 · push wave-drag peak ~M1.18 · do not sit on the shoulder

rows.label: Dash
rows.detail: Thin air · ram owns thrust · density-gated inlet forbids low-alt dash

rows.label: Recover
rows.detail: Arrive light · hook · 35 MJ strip · pattern school on Circuits

slides.bottomLine: Surviving the pass and hunting the recovery beats one of these. That is doctrine, not a bug.

slides.heading: High wing loading on purpose.
slides.subhead: Cruise and dash beat sustained low-speed G. Instantaneous G lives only in a fast, low dive box.
slides.bottomLine: 13 m · 7.35 m span · 18 m² · AR 3 · ~536 kg/m² at gross. Closed envelope; do not invent OML.

slides.heading: Thin sharp planform.
slides.subhead: Wave-drag peak is meant to be pushed through, not stopped at. Contrast the subsonic sibling walled at M0.85.
slides.figureCaption: Plate 02 — wing planform vertices from definition

slides.heading: Steel where the heat was — CMC where the heat is.
slides.subhead: Stagnation at M4-class flight is ~910 K. Stainless dies near 600 °C. The old cheap-steel story is superseded.

rows.label: Hot structure
rows.detail: SiC/SiC CMC · SkinTemperatureLimitK = 1473.15 (1200 °C) · closed materials freeze

rows.label: Cold structure
rows.detail: Ordinary composite elsewhere · mass and cost follow the hot zones

rows.label: Thermal vs thrust
rows.detail: CMC headroom ~M5.7 thermally · engine dies first ~M4.5 on thrust

rows.label: Skin HUD
rows.detail: Lagged structure (heat τ≈12 s, cool τ≈180 s) — dive no longer fake-cools the gauge

slides.bottomLine: CMC supports a hot dash story. It does not prove sustained Mach 4.

slides.heading: Where the heat lives.
slides.subhead: Leading edges, inlet lip, duct, nozzle — CMC. Capsule spine and outer skins — cooler composite.
slides.bottomLine: If the HUD cools on a decelerating dive, the model is lying. That bug is fixed; taus remain provisional.

slides.heading: One inlet. One nozzle. Continuous TBCC.
slides.subhead: Turbine and ram overlap — no hard engine swap that strands a heavy glider.

deck.title: Turbine core
deck.body:
84 kN sea-level static dry.
Sized for aug T/W ≤1.20 at design gross (four drones).

deck.title: Caution
deck.body:
Wet T/W ≤1.20 at design gross (11090 kg).
Family / Identity matched — Build 163.

deck.title: Turbine fade
deck.body: Core unloads as inlet total temperature rises.

deck.title: Open finding
deck.body:
Fuel is still lever-only.
Core can charge MIL fuel at zero thrust share.

deck.title: Ram light → full
deck.body:
Overlaps turbine fade.
Capture area 1.2 m² · burner 2300 K.

deck.title: What briefings say
deck.body: Mach 4 — treat as fiction until the map is honest.

slides.bottomLine: DesignMach 2.6 is a cycle normaliser, not the aircraft's top speed. Do not re-couple it to spill Mach.

slides.heading: Physical duct, not a fitted top speed.
slides.subhead: Thrust comes from ideal cycle through a fixed capture area and density schedule — climb before you accelerate.
slides.bottomLine: No thrust vectoring. Cold-gas RCS (40 kg) for collapsed-q coast only.

slides.heading: Heavy off the rail. Light on the wire.
slides.subhead: Fuel fraction ~47% — interceptor job, not a day-fighter tanking. Gear and wire only ever see recovery weight.

statWeekly.label: fuel fraction — still short of SR-71's ~59%

slides.bottomLine: Automation-assisted trap makes the gross mass affordable. CG travel with drone release remains provisional.

slides.heading: Envelope on one plate.
slides.subhead: Climb corridor, TBCC overlap, measured OFT peak, fiction M4 line — labelled.
slides.bottomLine: Prefer retuning propulsion and guidance over buffing the engine again to green an OFT.

slides.heading: Where it is still improbably good.
slides.subhead: Do not paper these. Correct toward credible bounds or keep them labelled fiction.

rows.label: Dash Mach
rows.detail: Brief M4 · OFT ~M3.69 · map comments: nothing sustains air-breathing M4

rows.label: Wet T/W
rows.detail: ≤1.20 at design gross · 84 kN · 11090 kg card (Build 163)

rows.label: Fuel model
rows.detail: Lever-only · falsifies ram-cruise economy · open finding

rows.label: Structure
rows.detail: 12 G qualified / 15 G override · aggressive for crewed interceptor

rows.label: Skin lag taus
rows.detail: 12 s heat / 180 s cool · provisional soak surrogates, not measured curves

slides.bottomLine: CMC yes. Mach 4 no — not until the map and Identity agree with telemetry.

slides.heading: No windscreen. Reclined occupant. Opaque escape spine.
slides.subhead: The pilot issues coarse intent; FBW holds bank and flies the fine control. That is the fiction that makes keyboard flight possible.
slides.bottomLine: Ownship gun 480 rounds. Four drone sockets provisional — packaging not closed.

slides.heading: Four belly cells — preferred, provisional.
slides.subhead: Trade C: 2×2 grid. Stow 4×360 kg = 1440 kg in MassKg; shed on release. Release ≤ M1.6 for drone skin.
slides.bottomLine: Gameplay load is four. Engineering packaging is provisional. Missing mass makes OFTs optimistic.

slides.heading: Buried gallery on flat steppe.
slides.subhead: Ukraine does not supply a natural 7° hill. The ramp is engineered; the strip is purpose-built.
slides.figureCaption: Plate 10 — basing interface · 14×8 gallery · 12° · 520 m · 35 MJ
slides.bottomLine: Airframe span 7.35 m from JSON; gallery clearance from bible §§70–80.

slides.heading: Soft world. Cold instruments.
slides.subhead: Ghibli-adjacent stills are fiction mood refs — not runtime source of truth. HUD stays phosphor/amber clinical.
slides.figureCaption: Fiction mood ref · provenance in analysis/art-refs/rapier/index.json
slides.bottomLine: Weathered mechanical honesty. Sealed capsule vs warm earth. No kill-porn.

slides.heading: How the next jet gets designed.
slides.subhead: Part I first. Then freeze geometry. Then plates and mesh. Never invent a bespoke createFoo without an exception note.

rows.label: 1 · Bible
rows.detail: docs/airframes/<name>/ — mission → geometry → thermal → propulsion → mass

rows.label: 2 · Definition
rows.detail: airframes/<name>.v1.json from schema · sync wwwroot + embedded JS

rows.label: 3 · Plates
rows.detail: blueprints/ from definition numbers only

rows.label: 4 · Mesh
rows.detail: createAirframeFromDefinition — thin loader, no silent OML rewrite

rows.label: 5 · Bind
rows.detail: presentation id + FlightModel identity share airframe id

slides.bottomLine: Rapier is jet #1 under the kit. Infrastructure captures first principles — it does not invent them.

slides.heading: Modules that sum to 5150 kg empty.
slides.subhead: BOM allocations are provisional; the sum is closed. Stowed drones are a separate +1440 kg state.

rows.label: A–C–F
rows.detail: Forward / centre / aft backbone + carry-through

rows.label: E
rows.detail: Propulsion tunnel + CMC duct + core (~1100 kg)

rows.label: B + D
rows.detail: Escape spine + wings

rows.label: Systems
rows.detail: Fuel dry, avionics, gear, hook, empty bays

slides.bottomLine: Plate 00 owns the mass budget. Do not grow OML to fix a packaging mistake.

slides.heading: Longerons, frames, spars.
slides.subhead: Primary structure is provisional but must hit closed loft stations and 12 G dive loads.
slides.bottomLine: Load paths never go through the CMC duct liner.

slides.heading: Mate order is the build.
slides.subhead: Keel → duct → spine → wings → systems → fins. Stop gates refuse Mach-4 / T/W fantasy acceptance.
slides.bottomLine: Blueprints + sim mass/T/W/per-stream fuel closed Build 163. Remaining: honest dash Mach, gauges, inertias.

slides.title: Build for the pass you pick.
slides.subtitle: High loading · CMC hot · continuous TBCC · trap light · measure the dash you actually get.
